packageRules.description: Newtonsoft.Json is pinned to 10.0.3 to match the assembly Playnite loads at runtime. The reference is ExcludeAssets=runtime, so the plugin binds to Playnite's copy; compiling against a newer version risks a MethodNotFound at load time inside Playnite's AppDomain. Do not bump without verifying what Playnite ships.
